svg.aria-label: The whole system drawn as a circle, its top edge the visible service. Where an experiment goes in, a spotlight opens down into the system. In the light, interpretation, legislation, operations, decision rights and relationships, each joined to the others by a fine line, passing over and under where they cross. The rest of the circle is hatched and labelled dark matter, with more materials faintly in it.
svg.title: The whole system as a circle whose top edge is the visible service. Where an experiment goes in, a spotlight opens into the system, and five materials and the relationships between them come into view. Hatching covers the rest, the service's dark matter, where more materials lie unseen
